summary: The checked-in focused tests pass, and the final eight-row real-tree receipt is internally consistent, but both repaired seams still admit false-clean behavior. Direct routeTrpc fixtures bypass the AppRouter-derived input/output validator, and clientgap's intersection fallback attributes unrelated server function return contracts to a consumed procedure by structural assignability alone.

findings.expected: Every ordinary route fixture passed to routeTrpc derives its procedure key, responder input, and success output from AppRouter; malformed or forward wire data requires malformedOrForwardTrpcWire.
findings.actual: TrpcRoutes gives each procedure an unknown value and routeTrpc accepts TrpcRoutes directly. defineTrpcRoutes performs the precise validation only when a caller opts into it. Across tests, 236 fixture files call routeTrpc outside the helper/type-test files, while defineTrpcRoutes appears only in its own type test.
findings.counterexample: A temporary type-test control called routeTrpc(page, { health: { ok: true, deletedField: "stale" } }) and routeTrpc(page, { "databank.list": (_input: string) => (...) }) under @ts-expect-error. Both directives were reported unused, proving the stale output and wrong responder input are accepted without the named escape.
findings.testDiscrimination: The committed negative controls wrap every invalid fixture in defineTrpcRoutes, so they prove only the opt-in validator. They never exercise the routeTrpc call shape used by the fixture corpus and therefore cannot catch this bypass.

findings.expected: A contract declaration is suppressed only when checker-resolved provenance connects it to the output of the specific consumed AppRouter procedure.
findings.actual: composedIntersectionReturns scans every explicit intersection return under packages/server/src. collectComposedIntersectionProvenance then accepts any such return structurally assignable to the selected output, without a call or declaration edge from that procedure. An unrelated server function can therefore hide a real client-gap row.
findings.counterexample: An in-memory project defined consumed AppRouter output LiveView and an unrelated function returning LiveView & UnrelatedServerOnlyView. collectAppRouterOutputProvenance reported both live=true and unrelatedServerOnly=true with unresolved=[], so UnrelatedServerOnlyView would be excluded from clientgap despite having no AppRouter path.
findings.testDiscrimination: The committed composed-intersection control declares composeResult but does not wire a composed property into probeRouter; it manually inserts probe.composed only in the AppRouter alias and consumed set. That test rewards the global structural sweep instead of proving a procedure-linked service return.
